edges.meaning: Sleep / Energy modulates Attention Regulation
edges.limitation: Sleep effects are transdiagnostic; no individual prediction.

edges.meaning: Sleep / Energy modulates Response Inhibition
edges.limitation: Sleep effects are transdiagnostic and task-dependent.

edges.meaning: Stress / Emotional Load modulates Attention Regulation
edges.limitation: Stress effects vary by task and are not ADHD-specific.

edges.meaning: Stress / Emotional Load modulates Working Memory
edges.limitation: Meta-analytic acute-stress evidence supports Working Memory effects; still transdiagnostic.

edges.meaning: Stress / Emotional Load modulates Emotional Regulation
edges.limitation: The exact Context→Regulation formulation is qualitative.

edges.meaning: Task Salience / Interest modulates Attention Regulation
edges.limitation: Motivation/salience can shape attention generally; not an ADHD-specific edge.

edges.meaning: Task Salience / Interest modulates Reward / Delay Processing
edges.limitation: Task interest/salience is broader than laboratory delay-discounting measures.

edges.meaning: Urgency / Time Pressure modulates Reward / Delay Processing
edges.limitation: Urgency is represented as changing consequence immediacy; direction is variable.

edges.meaning: Reward Salience / Immediacy modulates Reward / Delay Processing
edges.limitation: Reward delay/immediacy is directly relevant at construct level; no individual prediction.

edges.meaning: Task Demand / Complexity increases Working Memory demand
edges.limitation: Non-specific cognitive-demand mapping; not ADHD-specific causality.

edges.meaning: Task Demand / Complexity increases Goal Management demand
edges.limitation: Non-specific planning/organizational-demand mapping.

edges.meaning: External Structure may buffer Working Memory demand
edges.limitation: Guidance supports external structure; the Working Memory mechanism is an educational synthesis.

edges.meaning: External Structure may buffer Goal Management demand
edges.limitation: Guidance supports external structure; the Goal Management mechanism is an educational synthesis.

edges.meaning: Distraction / Interruptions interferes with Attention Regulation
edges.limitation: General interruption evidence, not ADHD-specific.

edges.meaning: Distraction / Interruptions increases Task Switching demand
edges.limitation: Interruptions create resumption/reorientation demand; ADHD-specific switching evidence is mixed.

edges.meaning: Attention Regulation contributes to Sustaining
edges.limitation: Sustaining is an observable educational Behaviour, not a laboratory vigilance score.

edges.meaning: Working Memory contributes to Keeping Track
edges.limitation: Keeping Track is an educational behavioural expression, not a direct Working Memory test.

edges.meaning: Working Memory contributes to Organizing / Sequencing
edges.limitation: Organizing/Sequencing can draw on multiple executive processes.

edges.meaning: Goal Management contributes to Starting
edges.limitation: Starting is multi-determined; Goal Management is one plausible contributor.

edges.meaning: Goal Management contributes to Organizing / Sequencing
edges.limitation: Planning/sequencing evidence supports the construct-level mapping.

edges.meaning: Goal Management contributes to Completing / Following Through
edges.limitation: Follow-through is multi-determined; this is not a unique mechanism.

edges.meaning: Response Inhibition contributes to Pausing / Waiting
edges.limitation: Response Inhibition is distinct from formal clinical impulsivity.

edges.meaning: Reward / Delay Processing contributes to Starting
edges.limitation: Group-level delay/reward evidence does not predict an individual's Starting.

edges.meaning: Reward / Delay Processing contributes to Sustaining
edges.limitation: Persistence/continued engagement is a broader behavioural interpretation.

edges.meaning: Emotional Regulation contributes to Starting
edges.limitation: Emotional Regulation is one possible contributor to Starting.

edges.meaning: Emotional Regulation contributes to Pausing / Waiting
edges.limitation: Pausing behaviour is not equivalent to an Emotional Regulation measure.

edges.meaning: Task Switching contributes to Switching Tasks
edges.limitation: Task-switching specificity in ADHD is mixed; keep Moderate status.

edges.meaning: BEH1 may contribute to recurring PAT1 when the pattern criteria are met
edges.limitation: Repeated intended maladaptive delay is required; one delayed start is insufficient.

edges.meaning: BEH2 may contribute to recurring PAT2 when the pattern criteria are met
edges.limitation: Everyday inconsistency must not be equated with laboratory reaction-time variability.

edges.meaning: BEH4 may contribute to recurring PAT2 when the pattern criteria are met
edges.limitation: Everyday inconsistency must not be equated with laboratory reaction-time variability.

edges.meaning: BEH6 may contribute to recurring PAT2 when the pattern criteria are met
edges.limitation: Everyday inconsistency must not be equated with laboratory reaction-time variability.
